description.en: Khalid wants his ball, but it isn't anywhere he looks.

cover.alt: Illustration pending: Khalid looking for his ball at home.

sentences.translation: There is a cat by the door.
The ball is under the cat!
He wants the ball very much.

text.full: يَقُولُ خَالِدٌ: «يَا لَيْلَى، هَلْ عِنْدَكِ الْكُرَةُ؟»

sentences.translation: Khalid says, “Layla, do you have the ball?”
Layla says, “No, I don't have a ball.”
Layla says, “There is a cat by the door.”
The ball is under the cat!
The cat is sitting on the ball!

text.full: يَقُولُ خَالِدٌ: «يَا قِطُّ، هَلْ تُرِيدُ الْكُرَةَ؟»

sentences.translation: Khalid says, “Cat, do you want the ball?”
The cat looks at the ball.
The cat looks at the ball.
Khalid gives the ball to the cat.
The cat plays with the ball.
Then the ball comes back to Khalid.
He wants the ball very much.

text.full: يَقُولُ خَالِدٌ: «يَا لَيْلَى، هَلْ عِنْدَكِ الْكُرَةُ؟»

sentences.translation: Khalid says, “Layla, do you have the ball?”
Layla says, “No, I don't have a ball.”
Layla says, “There is a cat by the door.”
The cat is sitting by the door.

text.full: يَقُولُ خَالِدٌ: «يَا قِطُّ، هَلْ عِنْدَكَ الْكُرَةُ؟»

sentences.translation: Khalid says, “Cat, do you have the ball?”
Then it looks at the floor.
There is a ball under the cat!
Khalid says, “The ball is under the cat!”
But the cat is sitting on the ball!

text.full: يَقُولُ خَالِدٌ: «يَا قِطُّ، هَلْ تُرِيدُ الْكُرَةَ؟»

sentences.translation: Khalid says, “Cat, do you want the ball?”
The cat looks at the ball.
Now the ball is by the door.
The cat looks at the ball.
Khalid says, “Do you want the ball?”
Khalid gives the ball to the cat.
The cat plays with the ball.
Then the ball comes back to Khalid.
Then he gives it to the cat.

text.full: تَقُولُ لَيْلَى: «يَا خَالِدُ، هَلْ عِنْدَكَ الْكُرَةُ الْآنَ؟»

sentences.translation: Layla says, “Khalid, do you have the ball now?”
Khalid says, “No, the cat has the ball!”
Then the ball comes back to Khalid.
Then the cat has the ball.

vocabulary.note: أُرِيدُ = I want · تُرِيدُ = you want

comprehension.instructions: Answer the questions about the story. Each answer links back to the sentence that shows it.

items.explanation: Khalid wants the ball. The whole story is about finding it.
Khalid looks in the kitchen, but there is no ball there. It is under the cat.
First the kitchen, then Layla. The cat gets up, and in the end Khalid plays with the cat.
Khalid laughs when he sees the cat sitting on his ball.

Write a different ending. Where is the ball now?
